classification.difficultyReason: Isolate a trigonometric ratio, identify its exact related angle and select both solutions in the specified interval.

content.prompt: Without using a calculator, solve each equation for $0^\circ\leq\theta\leq360^\circ$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2\sin\theta&=1\\\sin\theta&=\frac12\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $30^\circ$. Sine is positive in quadrants I and II.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=30^\circ\text{ or }180^\circ-30^\circ\\\theta&=30^\circ\text{ or }150^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}2\sin\theta&=\sqrt3\\\sin\theta&=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $60^\circ$. Sine is positive in quadrants I and II.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=60^\circ\text{ or }180^\circ-60^\circ\\\theta&=60^\circ\text{ or }120^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}2\sin\theta&=-\sqrt3\\\sin\theta&=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $60^\circ$. Sine is negative in quadrants III and IV.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ+60^\circ\text{ or }360^\circ-60^\circ\\\theta&=240^\circ\text{ or }300^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}4\cos\theta-2&=0\\4\cos\theta&=2\\\cos\theta&=\frac12\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $60^\circ$. Cosine is positive in quadrants I and IV.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=60^\circ\text{ or }360^\circ-60^\circ\\\theta&=60^\circ\text{ or }300^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}9\tan\theta&=9\\\tan\theta&=1\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $45^\circ$. Tangent is positive in quadrants I and III.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=45^\circ\text{ or }180^\circ+45^\circ\\\theta&=45^\circ\text{ or }225^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\sqrt3\tan\theta&=-1\\\tan\theta&=-\frac1{\sqrt3}\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $30^\circ$. Tangent is negative in quadrants II and IV.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-30^\circ\text{ or }360^\circ-30^\circ\\\theta&=150^\circ\text{ or }330^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}2\cos\theta+\sqrt3&=0\\2\cos\theta&=-\sqrt3\\\cos\theta&=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $30^\circ$. Cosine is negative in quadrants II and III.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-30^\circ\text{ or }180^\circ+30^\circ\\\theta&=150^\circ\text{ or }210^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\frac1{\sqrt3}\tan\theta&=1\\\tan\theta&=\sqrt3\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $60^\circ$. Tangent is positive in quadrants I and III.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=60^\circ\text{ or }180^\circ+60^\circ\\\theta&=60^\circ\text{ or }240^\circ\end{align*}$$
